title: Choose your working route
steps: Choose live, local Python, or paper.
Use the final three minutes to review evidence.
done_when: By minute 25, everyone has a route; by minute 28, a policy prediction.
fallback: Packet P0/P1: no login, terminal, download or partner needed.
notes: Five minutes maximum readiness/recovery plus three minutes evidence/transition; not eight minutes of setup.

title: Build the checklist
steps: Copy workbook L1 prompt, or repair packet P1.
Check each system’s deadline and evidence.
done_when: Four systems, correct deadline, verification/evidence, and unresolved decisions.
fallback: Packet P1: correct the flawed draft and write one evidence row.
notes: Stop at minute 41. Do not project the full prompt or answer specimen during work.

title: Build and check the triage script
steps: Predict rows using workbook L2 rules.
Review generated code before running it.
Compare exact IDs, source values and reasons.
Explain one boundary and one limitation.
done_when: Checked output matches the hand key; input remains unchanged; one boundary explained.
fallback: At minute 68 use reviewed reference code or packet P2.
notes: Stop generation at minute 75. S14A/S14B may replace this view during its existing work time.

title: Build a local review report
steps: Use the checked CSV, not invented output.
Build static HTML with escaped data.
Trace the display to a source row.
done_when: Four events, three categories, exact values, safe text, no compromise claim.
fallback: At minute 98 use reviewed reference or packet P3.
notes: Stop features at minute 105. No scanner, server, external assets or dependency installation.

title: One folder; three routes
shell_context: Linux/WSL Bash terminal · prepared kit only
points: Live agent: approved access and normal permissions.
Local Python: reviewed references; no AI account.
Paper: packet P0–P3; same evidence decisions.
workbook_ref: R0 · Linux guide: In the room
fallback: If the prepared folder is absent, use packet P0.
notes: Optional support, no added minutes. Commands assume the organizer prepared exactly this kit layout; never run preflight on macOS/native Windows as a Linux-success check. Discovery does not prove model access, sandboxing or WSL2.

title: Run, then compare the exact rows
points: Read the proposed code and output path first.
A count alone cannot verify the result.
code:
python3 work/triage.py \
  labs/signins.csv work/flagged-events.csv
python3 labs/check_triage.py work/flagged-events.csv
fallback: Reference command in L2, or hand-review packet P2.
notes: Zero extra time inside slide 14. work/triage.py must implement the workbook CLI contract before this command is used. Dollar prompt markers belong to design only, never copied commands.

title: When the checker disagrees
points: Exactly ten minutes counts; equal timestamps do not.
Trace the first mismatch before rewriting everything.
fallback: Use the reference or correct specimen B manually.
notes: Zero extra time. Does not reveal the four correct IDs. At minute 75 reveal the key on core slide 15; do not continue generation.

title: Check the report against the CSV
points: Four events; three distinct reason categories.
Trace one UTC timestamp to source.
Render data as text; no compromise verdict.
fallback: Reviewed reference or paper screen; record what actually ran.
notes: Zero extra time. Substitute checked reference-events.csv if needed. Additional empty/markup tests use supplied files at the checkpoint, not a feature build.
